{
  "case_goal": "Verify that a user can successfully log in to phpMyAdmin using valid credentials (admin/admin) and that the user info element is displayed after login. The process is performed twice to ensure repeatability.",
  "summary": "Navigate to phpMyAdmin login page, clear and enter username 'admin', clear and enter password 'admin', click login button, verify that the user info element (li_user_info) is present on the resulting page. Then repeat the entire process a second time.",
  "steps": [
    {
      "step_number": 1,
      "action_type": "get",
      "target": "url",
      "value": "http://phpmyadmin-old.local:8092/",
      "page_url": "http://phpmyadmin-old.local:8092/",
      "expected_result": "Login page loaded with username, password fields and submit button"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 2,
      "action_type": "clear_and_send_keys",
      "target": "id=input_username",
      "value": "admin",
      "page_url": "http://phpmyadmin-old.local:8092/",
      "expected_result": "Username field cleared and populated with 'admin'"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 3,
      "action_type": "clear_and_send_keys",
      "target": "id=input_password",
      "value": "admin",
      "page_url": "http://phpmyadmin-old.local:8092/",
      "expected_result": "Password field cleared and populated with 'admin'"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 4,
      "action_type": "click",
      "target": "id=input_go",
      "value": "",
      "page_url": "http://phpmyadmin-old.local:8092/",
      "expected_result": "Login form submitted, page navigates to index.php with title containing 'phpmyadmin-db-old'"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 5,
      "action_type": "verify_element",
      "target": "id=li_user_info",
      "value": "",
      "page_url": "http://phpmyadmin-old.local:8092/index.php",
      "expected_result": "Element with id 'li_user_info' is present, indicating successful login"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 6,
      "action_type": "get",
      "target": "url",
      "value": "http://phpmyadmin-old.local:8092/",
      "page_url": "http://phpmyadmin-old.local:8092/",
      "expected_result": "Login page loaded again (possibly after logout or navigation)"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 7,
      "action_type": "clear_and_send_keys",
      "target": "id=input_username",
      "value": "admin",
      "page_url": "http://phpmyadmin-old.local:8092/",
      "expected_result": "Username field cleared and populated with 'admin'"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 8,
      "action_type": "clear_and_send_keys",
      "target": "id=input_password",
      "value": "admin",
      "page_url": "http://phpmyadmin-old.local:8092/",
      "expected_result": "Password field cleared and populated with 'admin'"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 9,
      "action_type": "click",
      "target": "id=input_go",
      "value": "",
      "page_url": "http://phpmyadmin-old.local:8092/",
      "expected_result": "Login form submitted again"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 10,
      "action_type": "verify_element",
      "target": "id=li_user_info",
      "value": "",
      "page_url": "http://phpmyadmin-old.local:8092/index.php",
      "expected_result": "Element with id 'li_user_info' is present, confirming second login"
    }
  ]
}
